purpose: Turn the audited idle cross-cumulant gap into complete filter-budget feasibility, before new audio or C adoption. Two explicitly separate model families; no silent fallback.
inputs: Frozen idle_joint_cumulant_v1 raw training/check matrices and architecture responses, preserving13OSC/6FIR/gain/LR. Four high innovation inputs only; low2 remain independent Gaussian. No new source selection or download.

families.variance_factors: q_i=sqrt(V_i)*z_i, independent Gaussian carriers, E[V_i]=1. D=Cov(V) has latent diag cumulant3D_ii and mixed iijj cumulantD_ij. Seek nonnegative factor D=W*W^T. Exact fit may be impossible; reject indefinite solution, do not project it.
families.compound_sign_groups: Independent white compound-Poisson groups with independent Rademacher signs per input/jump, plus independent Gaussian remainder. C=sum lambda_g*a_g^2*(a_g^2)^T; latent diag and mixed iijj cumulants both C_ij (diagonal coefficient1). Nonnegative factor C=W*W^T certifies realizability for sufficiently small rates. This is statistical excitation around preserved OSC, not identified firings.

operator: Full10x10 linear map from symmetric4x4 latent even cumulants to all4output marginal+6mixed cumulants. Diagonal coefficient d*sum(h_bi^2*h_ci^2), d3or1 by family. Offdiagonal coefficient sum(h_bi^2*h_cj^2+h_bj^2*h_ci^2+4h_bi*h_bj*h_ci*h_cj). Include filter phase/sign overlap, not only squared-envelope product. Source target Q_train*model_variance_outer minus finite original main term.
solve: Only TRAIN observed moments; exactly one full linear solve per family after row normalization by frozen model variances and column-coordinate normalization. SVD rank threshold machineepsilon*dimension*smax. Rank deficient is UNKNOWN, no pseudoinverse/profile. Preserve unconstrained solutions even if invalid. Relative PSD/entry/factor residual tolerance1e-10; never eigenvalue clipping, nearestPSD, relaxed moments, threshold or optimizer sweep.
certificate: If latent matrix positive definite, try its deterministic unpivoted Cholesky once. Require every factor entry>=0 and relative reconstruction<=1e-10; no clipping/reordering/rotation/search. Failure to get this sufficient factor is UNKNOWN, not proof no other factor exists. Indefinite matrix contradicts the declared positive-factor family under the fixed budget. For valid variance factor, common Bernoulli variance-scale p<1/(1+max(rowsumW)^2) guarantees V>0; for jump factor, common lambda<1/max(rowsumW)^2 leaves nonnegative Gaussian variance. These are existence intervals, not source-derived rates or selected synthesis settings.
controls_first: Exact weighted shared-mark Gaussian-to-fourth-order ensemble through2independent FIR taps validates all output terms. Independent Poisson/binomial quadrature lambda.125/count0..12 validates Rademacher compound diag and cross cumulants. For BOTH families invert known feasible factor, reject known indefinite latent target, retain rank-deficient UNKNOWN. All known controls before real inputs.
check: Only after immutable TRAIN solutions/certificates are saved, report fixed normalized predictions versus previously inspected F2 check moments and old independent model. Invalid algebraic relaxations labeled non-generative; never call their error decrease a usable improvement. Full check is same recording, not pristine or physical-source validation.
verification: Independent full fourth-tensor contraction of every saved operator, compensated known ensemble moments/Poisson tail, independent SVD solve/rank/eigen/certificate/predictions; input manifests/exact executed sources. No new audio/profile/C/default/UI/driver/take changes or unrelated61driving tests.
limits: Equal second/fourth moments do not identify event rate, waveform, full tensor or perceptual naturalness. Gaussian scale and compound-sign classes are limited hypotheses, not exhaustive engine laws. No actual RPM/load, firing time or shared crank phase.
